# `particle_voice/nn/memory/WeightPageUploader.js`

> **Source:** `agi/particle_voice/nn/memory/WeightPageUploader.js`

WeightPageUploader.js — Phase 1 ParticleNN memory. Orchestrates `WeightPageStore.js` (download+hash-verify) and `WeightBindWindow.js` (GPU upload) together: priority-ordered upload, resumability (skip already-uploaded pages), and device-loss re-upload — the exact three properties R8 (`risk/WeightPagingProbe.js`) proved for a single/multi-page toy case, generalized here to an arbitrary page count and caller-chosen priority order.

## Classes

### `class WeightPageUploader`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(pageStore, bindWindow)` |  |
| `isUploaded` | `isUploaded(pageIndex)` |  |
| `uploadPages` | `async uploadPages(priorityOrder, { onProgress } = {})` | Upload `priorityOrder` (an array of page indices, caller-chosen — e.g. from `WeightResidencyPlan.diff().toLoad`, ordered by nearest upcoming segment first) to the GPU, downloading+verifying via `pageStore` first if not already resident. Already-uploaded pages are skipped — safe to call again after an interrupted call (the "resume" property). |
| `evictPage` | `evictPage(pageIndex)` | Evict a page from both the GPU (`WeightBindWindow`) and the uploaded-set bookkeeping — `pageStore`'s own cached bytes are untouched (call `pageStore.evict()` separately if the host copy should also be dropped). |
| `reuploadAfterDeviceLoss` | `async reuploadAfterDeviceLoss(newDevice)` | Device-loss recovery: build a fresh `WeightBindWindow` against `newDevice` and re-upload every previously-uploaded page. Re-downloads from `pageStore` only for pages that are no longer host-resident (e.g. evicted under memory pressure before the loss) — otherwise reuses the already-verified cached bytes, matching R8's `uploadAllPagesAndVerify` re-run-on-a-new-device pattern. |

## Functions

### `attachDeviceLossRecovery(device, uploader, recreateDevice, { maxBackoffMs = 8000 } = {})`

Wire the `device.lost` recovery contract from `DeviceContract-v0.md` §5: skip recovery if `reason === 'destroyed'` (intentional disposal, not a crash); otherwise recreate the device with exponential backoff and call `uploader.reuploadAfterDeviceLoss(newDevice)`.

## Notes & Examples

### Where this fits in the training loop

AGI runs an **observation → brain → action → reward** loop each tick: observations are gathered from the world, a brain maps them to actions, the rig applies motion, and rewards shape the next update.

**Example: Minimal training loop**
```js
import { Agent } from 'agi/core/Agent.js';
import { World } from 'agi/env/World.js';

const world = new World();
const agent = new Agent({
  brain: 'ppo',
  observationSpace: world.observationSpace,
  actionSpace: world.actionSpace
});

for (let step = 0; step < 10000; step++) {
  const obs = world.getObservation();      // Gather observations
  const action = agent.act(obs);            // Brain decides action
  const { reward, done } = world.step(action); // Apply action, get reward
  agent.learn(obs, action, reward);         // Update from experience
  
  if (done) world.reset();
}
```

**See also:** [AGI Training Guide](/agi/training-guide.md) · [AGI Architecture](/agi/architecture.md)
